description: Feature-validate proceeds against the working tree when dev-{N}.json is missing but git ground truth finds real work.
failure_mode: Model reports 'no implementation work' or exits even though feature-dev left real changes on disk.
prompt: Phase 0 of feature-validate finds .nightgauge/pipeline/dev-134.json missing. You run `nightgauge gate verify feature-dev 134 --workdir . --json` and it reports terminal_kind: "dev_handoff_missing" with 2 files (internal/scan/testcmd.go, cmd/nightgauge/main.go) and exit code 2. What do you do?

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\bno implementation work\b|\bnothing to validate\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: concluding there is no work or nothing to validate; rejecting that conclusion is fine
